title: About Us
summary: Learn about Hengxin Professional Services, an accounting, tax and company secretarial team in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur.
content: About Us   Hengxin Professional Services is a professional services firm in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur. We offer three services to local businesses: accounting and audit, tax advisory, and company secretarial.   Our philosophy   "Hengxin" stands for lasting, reliable trust. We believe financial and compliance support should be clear, accurate and delivered on time, so business owners can focus on their business.   How we work      Clear communication : we explain numbers and regulatory requirements in plain language.    On-time delivery : we remind you ahead of filing and tax deadlines.    One team : accounting, tax and company secretarial matters are coordinated by the same team, so documents don't pass back and forth.     To learn more, please  contact us .

title: Services

content: Services   Accounting & Audit   We provide day-to-day bookkeeping, monthly and annual financial statements, and support during audits for small and medium businesses. Tax Advisory   We offer tax planning, filing preparation and compliance advice. We help you understand your tax obligations, file on time, and consider the tax side of everyday business decisions.
